layout_description: Headline and subhead across the top; three real pack shots in a row across the middle, each with one short label beneath. A thin band under the products carries the CTA. Footnote bottom.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a cool white and pale blue surface with a few small ice-like crystals and water droplets only along the outer edges, soft cool light. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the middle 80% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit and keep any props in the outer edges. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
